description_en: Checks whether Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances exist
name: CheckUserHasEcs

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

schema.description_zh: 校验是否含有ECS返回数据

Code.description_en: The status code returned. The status code 200 indicates that the request is successful. Other status codes indicate that the request fails. You can identify the cause of the failure based on the status code
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether ECS instances exist. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
Data.description_zh:
是否含有ECS。取值：

true：含有
false：未有
